Class ItemTaskObserver

java.lang.Object
org.tasktide.engine.observer.ObserverChain<ItemTask>
org.tasktide.engine.observer.chain.ItemTaskObserver
All Implemented Interfaces:
TaskTideEngineObserver<ItemTask>, TaskTideWorkerUnit<ItemTask>
public class ItemTaskObserver extends ObserverChain<ItemTask>
Coordinates the work across the WorkerObservers for the processing of WorkItem through the TaskTideEngineObserver chain for ItemTasks
